title: Light
description: The service behind M Scenes. Writes the BDC's interior-ambient workshop jobs (INNENLICHT_FI_LIN_1_LAYERING / _FI_LIN_2_LAYERING, SID 2E, DIDs DA5E and E3D1) through the head unit's diagnostic gateway (TASU) via hmictl. Exposes a JSON-line control socket at /run/edzco-light/ctl.sock. Each write lasts up to 254 s on the car; the tool renews every 120 s while a scene is active and stops by itself when the app disconnects or asks for Stop. Nothing on the car's own coding is changed - the colours disappear 254 s after the last renewal and the car's own ambient takes over again.
